eval.behavior_en: Runs one accuracy evaluation: serving / native mode with engines benchscope / native-hf / mock; writes task.json / result.json / samples.jsonl.

performance.name: Bench CLI
performance.description_zh: BenchScope 自研测试引擎（Bench CLI），基于 OpenAI 兼容 API 的进程内异步流式负载生成器。 不依赖本地 vLLM / SGLang 环境，pip 安装后即可对本地或远程的任意 OpenAI 兼容推理服务进行性能测试。 指标口径严格对齐 vLLM bench（TTFT / TPOT / ITL / 吞吐量），结果可与原生引擎直接对比。 同时提供 Serving 链路精度评测能力（内置命令 `benchscope eval`）。
performance.description_en: BenchScope built-in engine (Bench CLI) — an in-process async load generator for OpenAI-compatible APIs. No local vLLM / SGLang installation is required, so any local or remote OpenAI-compatible service can be tested right after pip install. Metrics follow the vLLM bench definitions (TTFT / TPOT / ITL / throughput), so results are directly comparable with the native engines. Also provides serving-link accuracy evaluation via the built-in `benchscope eval` command.

performance.name: vLLM 0.23
performance.description_zh: vLLM 原生引擎，调用本地安装的 vllm bench serve CLI 执行测试。 指标为 vLLM 官方口径，可作为校验 Bench CLI 结果的基线参考。
performance.description_en: vLLM native engine — invokes the locally installed vllm bench serve CLI. Metrics are the official vLLM baseline, serving as the reference for cross-checking Bench CLI results.

performance.name: SGLang 0.5.10
performance.description_zh: SGLang 原生引擎，调用本地 python -m sglang.bench_serving CLI 执行测试。 输出 SGLang 原生指标（TPOT / ITL），便于与 vLLM 及 Bench CLI 横向对比。
performance.description_en: SGLang native engine — invokes the local python -m sglang.bench_serving CLI. Reports SGLang-native metrics (TPOT / ITL) for comparison with vLLM and Bench CLI.

accuracy.name: Native HF
accuracy.description_zh: Native 原生精度引擎，经 transformers 本地加载模型权重（路径或 HF id）离线推理。 固定种子 100% 可复现；支持 LoRA 微调训练的增量模型（peft adapter，lora_path 配置）。 需当前环境已安装 torch 与 transformers（选择前环境校验；可选依赖，不随 pip 必装）。
accuracy.description_en: Native accuracy engine — loads local model weights (path or HF id) with transformers and runs offline inference. 100% reproducible with a fixed seed; supports LoRA fine-tuned incremental models via peft adapters (lora_path). Requires torch and transformers in the current environment (validated before selection; optional extras, not bundled with pip install).

accuracy.name: Mock
accuracy.description_zh: Mock 精度引擎，按样本返回确定性伪输出，正确率可控（mock_correct_rate，默认 0.7）。 用于无 GPU / 无真实推理服务场景的全链路联调、演示与测试（mock 环境定位）。
accuracy.description_en: Mock accuracy engine — returns deterministic pseudo answers with a controllable correctness rate (mock_correct_rate, default 0.7). For full-pipeline integration, demos and tests without GPU or a real inference service.

ttft.def_zh: 从请求发出到收到第一个生成 token 的耗时，反映用户感知的首字响应速度，越低越好。
ttft.def_en: Time from request send to the first generated token; reflects perceived first-token responsiveness, lower is better.

tpot.name_zh: 每输出 token 延迟 TPOT
tpot.def_zh: 生成每个输出 token 的平均耗时，决定流式输出的持续流畅度，越低越好。
tpot.def_en: Average time to generate each output token; determines sustained streaming smoothness, lower is better.

itl.def_zh: 相邻两个输出 token 之间的间隔耗时，刻画流式输出的抖动与卡顿，越低越好。
itl.def_en: Gap between consecutive output tokens; characterizes streaming jitter/stutter, lower is better.

output.def_zh: 服务端生成的输出 token 速率（总输出 token 数 / 压测时长），越高越好。
output.def_en: Rate of generated output tokens (total output tokens / duration), higher is better.

peakoutput.def_zh: 压测窗口内观察到的输出 token 速率峰值（vLLM 口径提供；SGLang 原生输出无此项时记 N/A）。
peakoutput.def_en: Peak output token rate observed in the window (vLLM provides it; recorded as N/A when the engine does not).

total.def_zh: 输入 + 输出 token 的总处理速率（总 token 数 / 压测时长），衡量服务整体处理容量，越高越好。
total.def_en: Combined input + output token processing rate (total tokens / duration), measures overall capacity, higher is better.

req_per_s.def_zh: 每秒完成的请求数（成功请求数 / 压测时长），衡量服务承载的请求速率，越高越好。
req_per_s.def_en: Completed requests per second (successful requests / duration), higher is better.

single_user.def_zh: 单个用户可获得的生成速率，按 1000 / TPOT(mean) 推导，近似单人连续生成速度。
single_user.def_en: Generation rate available to a single user, derived as 1000 / TPOT(mean), approximating single-user speed.

successful_requests.def_zh: 压测中成功完成的请求数（收到完整响应）。
successful_requests.def_en: Requests that completed successfully with a full response.

failed_requests.def_zh: 压测中失败的请求数（超时 / 错误 / 未完成），健康压测中应为 0。
failed_requests.def_en: Requests that failed (timeout / error / incomplete); should be 0 in a healthy run.

benchmark_duration.def_zh: 整轮压测的墙钟时长（从首个请求发出到全部请求结束）。
benchmark_duration.def_en: Wall-clock duration of the whole run (first request sent to last request finished).

total_input_tokens.def_zh: 本轮压测发送的全部输入 token 总量。
total_input_tokens.def_en: Total input tokens sent in this run.

total_generated_tokens.def_zh: 本轮压测服务端生成的全部输出 token 总量。
total_generated_tokens.def_en: Total output tokens generated by the service in this run.

peak_concurrent.def_zh: 压测过程中同时在途的请求数峰值。
peak_concurrent.def_en: Peak number of in-flight requests during the run.

best_concurrency.def_zh: 阈值模式下满足全部阈值条件（TTFT / TPOT / 输出吞吐）的最大并发；达到搜索上限仍满足时取上限。
best_concurrency.def_en: In threshold mode, the maximum concurrency satisfying all thresholds (TTFT / TPOT / output throughput); the search cap is used when it still satisfies.

export.csv_note_zh: 汇总 CSV 按用例分组，含「测试条件」标题行与 并发数/Output/Peak Output/Total/TTFT/TPOT/ITL 列（mean 或 P99 两套）。
export.csv_note_en: Summary CSV is grouped by case with a condition header row and columns concurrency/Output/Peak Output/Total/TTFT/TPOT/ITL (mean or P99 sets).

conclusion_rules.rule_zh: 总样本 = 0 或无效样本占比 > 20%

accuracy.def_zh: 正确样本数 / 总样本数，精度评测的核心主指标。
accuracy.def_en: Correct samples / total samples; the core accuracy metric.

pass_rate.def_zh: 有效可解析样本占比 =（总样本 - 无效样本）/ 总样本，衡量回答可被判分的比例。
pass_rate.def_en: Share of parseable samples = (total - invalid) / total; measures how many answers can be scored.

total_samples.def_zh: 本轮评测实际执行的样本总数。

correct_samples.def_zh: 判分结果为正确的样本数。

wrong_samples.def_zh: 可判分但结果错误的样本数。

invalid_samples.def_zh: 无法解析 / 无法判分的样本数（格式错误、未作答等）。
invalid_samples.def_en: Samples that could not be parsed or scored.

subjects.def_zh: 按数据集 subject 字段分组的逐学科正确率（subject 为空的样本不参与）。
subjects.def_en: Per-subject accuracy grouped by the dataset's subject field (samples without subject are excluded).

error_tag_summary.def_zh: 错误样本的归因标签计数（如「知识错误」），用于定位薄弱能力。
error_tag_summary.def_en: Counts of error-attribution tags on wrong samples (e.g. "knowledge error"), used to locate weak abilities.

exact_match.def_zh: 数学题最终答案与标准答案精确匹配的样本占比（math 判分器）。
exact_match.def_en: Share of math samples whose final answer exactly matches the reference (math scorer).

math_accuracy.def_zh: 数学类数据集主指标，与 exact_match 同口径。
math_accuracy.def_en: Primary metric for math datasets; same basis as exact_match.

answer_parse_rate.def_zh: 能从模型回答中提取出可判分答案的样本占比（math 判分器）。
answer_parse_rate.def_en: Share of samples whose answer could be extracted for scoring (math scorer).

pass_at_1.def_zh: 单次生成即通过全部测试用例的样本占比（code 判分器主指标）。
pass_at_1.def_en: Share of samples whose single generation passes all test cases (code scorer primary metric).

compile_rate.def_zh: 生成代码可成功编译 / 执行的样本占比（code 判分器）。
compile_rate.def_en: Share of generated code that compiles / executes (code scorer).

case_pass_rate.def_zh: 全部样本的测试用例总体通过率（通过用例数 / 总用例数，code 判分器）。
case_pass_rate.def_en: Overall test-case pass rate across samples (passed cases / total cases, code scorer).

mt_bench_score.def_zh: LLM 评审的两轮对话平均分（首轮均分 × 0.5 + 二轮均分 × 0.5，judge 判分器主指标）。
mt_bench_score.def_en: Average LLM-judge score over two dialogue turns (first × 0.5 + second × 0.5, judge scorer primary metric).

first_turn_score.def_zh: MT-Bench 第一轮对话的评审平均分。
first_turn_score.def_en: Average judge score for the first dialogue turn.

second_turn_score.def_zh: MT-Bench 第二轮对话的评审平均分（考察对首轮上下文的继承）。
second_turn_score.def_en: Average judge score for the second turn (tests context inheritance from the first turn).

dim_helpfulness.def_zh: 评审的有用性（helpfulness）维度平均分。
dim_helpfulness.def_en: Average judge score on the helpfulness dimension.

dim_truthfulness.def_zh: 评审的真实性（truthfulness）维度平均分。
dim_truthfulness.def_en: Average judge score on the truthfulness dimension.

dim_harmlessness.def_zh: 评审的无害性（harmlessness）维度平均分。
dim_harmlessness.def_en: Average judge score on the harmlessness dimension.

prompt_tokens_total.def_zh: 本轮评测全部请求的输入（prompt）token 总量（Serving 模式）。
prompt_tokens_total.def_en: Total prompt tokens across all requests (serving mode).

completion_tokens_total.def_zh: 本轮评测全部响应的输出（completion）token 总量（Serving 模式）。
completion_tokens_total.def_en: Total completion tokens across all responses (serving mode).

total_tokens.def_zh: 输入 + 输出 token 总量，用于成本核算。
total_tokens.def_en: Prompt + completion tokens; used for cost accounting.

avg_prompt_tokens_per_sample.def_zh: 输入 token 总量 / 总样本数。

avg_completion_tokens_per_sample.def_zh: 输出 token 总量 / 总样本数。

baseline_used.def_zh: 参与对标的开源基线模型名（基线库中同尺寸段最优 / 指定模型）。
baseline_used.def_en: Open-source baseline model name used for comparison (best in the same size segment, or specified).

diff_pp.def_zh: 本次主指标得分与基线得分的差值（百分点），正数表示优于基线。
diff_pp.def_en: Difference between the primary score and the baseline (percentage points); positive means above baseline.

grade.def_zh: 按与同尺寸段最优基线的差值评级：S ≥ 0；A ≥ -5；B ≥ -15；其余为 C。
grade.def_en: Grade by diff vs the best same-size baseline: S ≥ 0; A ≥ -5; B ≥ -15; otherwise C.

conclusion.unit: 合格 / 精度下跌 / 异常
conclusion.def_zh: 最终结论三选一：总样本为 0 或无效占比 > 20% → 异常；主指标较基线下降 > 5pp → 精度下跌；否则 → 合格。
conclusion.def_en: One of three: total = 0 or invalid ratio > 20% → abnormal; primary metric drops > 5pp vs baseline → accuracy drop; otherwise → pass.

estimate.def_zh: 评测前的消耗预估：prompt/completion/total tokens、预计耗时 est_seconds、估算来源 source（内置样本均值 / 字符估算）。Native 模式恒为 0（无线上链路消耗）。
estimate.def_en: Pre-run cost estimate: prompt/completion/total tokens, est_seconds, source (builtin sample means / char heuristic). Native mode is always 0 (no serving link).
